# Amrev Consulting Group

> Mining finance and tax advisory practice based at 201, Blohum Rd, Accra, Ghana.
> Works with mining groups in Ghana and South Africa on royalty and tax compliance,
> group consolidation, cash flow forecasting, internal audit, procurement cost
> review and transaction support. Founded and run by Abhinav Verma.

Contact: +233 25 731 9254 (phone and WhatsApp), experimentsav@gmail.com
Book a call: https://calendly.com/experimentsav/30min

## What Amrev is not
Amrev is not a licensed audit firm, is not licensed by the Institute of Chartered
Accountants Ghana, is not a registered South African audit firm, and does not sign
statutory audit opinions. It provides financial and tax advisory work and prepares
groups for audit alongside their licensed auditor. It does not provide legal advice.

## Entry engagement
The 21-Day Mining Fiscal Exposure Review: a fixed-scope, fixed-fee review covering
royalty recalculation, tax and filing exposure, consolidation integrity, and a
13-week cash forecast. Findings delivered on the agreed date or the final
instalment is waived. Works from documents the client already produces; no system
access required.

## Reference content
- Ghana's 2026 mining fiscal changes, full register with sources:
  /ghana-mining-fiscal-changes-2026.html
  Covers the sliding-scale royalty under L.I. 2517 in force 10 March 2026 (gold 5%
  below $2,000/oz rising to 12% above $4,500/oz), the Growth and Sustainability Levy
  cut from 3% to 1% effective 31 March 2026, mandatory e-invoicing from 1 July 2026,
  the GRA ITAS rollout in September 2026, and the Minerals Commission sector audit
  that ran from November 2025 to June 2026.
- Refined vs unrefined mineral royalty classification in South Africa:
  /south-africa-mining-royalty-classification.html
  Covers the Mineral and Petroleum Resources Royalty Act formulas, capped at 5% for
  refined and 7% for unrefined mineral resources with a 0.5% floor.

## Legal
- Privacy and cookie policy: /privacy.html
- Terms of use: /terms.html

Analytics and advertising tags (Google, Meta pixel) load only after the visitor
consents via the site's cookie banner; Google Consent Mode v2 defaults are set to
denied. Visitors can change or withdraw consent from the Cookie settings link in
the footer of every page.

Note: figures shown in the dashboard illustration on the home page are sample data,
not client results. Amrev publishes no client names, logos or testimonials. The site
content is general information for finance professionals, not tax, legal or
financial advice, and no client relationship arises from reading it.
